column1: ## QSSI 2026 Adversarial Testing and Robustness Assessment
This file contains the finalized CRITIC (Criteria Importance Through Intercriteria Correlation) weights used in the Quantum Sovereign Security Index (QSSI) 2026 framework.
The CRITIC methodology generates objective indicator weights by simultaneously accounting for indicator variability and inter-indicator correlation structure.

The CRITIC weighting procedure assigns the highest importance to Post-Quantum Cybersecurity Readiness (PQC), reflecting its combination of informational variability and relative independence from the remaining dimensions.

Artificial Intelligence Capability (AI_INDEX), National Resilience (RES_INDEX), and Legal Governance Quality (LEGAL_WGI_SCORE) contribute substantially to the composite framework while maintaining balanced representation across sovereign capability domains.
Results were generated using the finalized QSSI 2026 computational framework and harmonized sovereign dataset.
*QSSI 2026 Adversarial Testing and Robustness Assessment: FAIR+D Canon™ Global Framework.*
